summary: Full **Inventari** (`board` & `admin` only): CRUD `/api/v1/inventory-items` with variant editor & supplier reorder fields (`supplierContact`, `supplierReference`, `minOrderQty`, `leadTime`, `lastOrderedAt`), atomic `POST .../adjust` and `POST .../sell` (tracking `unitsSold` & `revenue`), protected image upload/delete, `GET .../summary`, and web UI with clickable KPI filter cards, variant chips, `REGISTRA VENDA` & `Informació de comanda` modals. **Server + web (wasmJs)**.
overview:
Fase 2 slice for tracking colla merchandising, clothing, technical gear, and other equipment with per-variant stock, low-stock alerts, supplier reorder info, and merchandising sales tracking.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §4.4, §5.8, §6.7 (inventario), §7.4 (Inventari), §10.2 · `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-schema-v02` (`inventory_items` incl. supplier reorder & sales columns, `inventory_variants`), `platform-core-contract` (`InventoryItem*`, `InventorySellRequest`, `MoneyCents`, `PatchField`), `platform-server-auth`, `platform-files` (for protected item images), `platform-web-shell`, `platform-openapi-deploy`.

**Key business rules (§5.8, §6.7 & `decisiones.md`)**
- **Strictly `board` and `admin` only** (`anonymous` → 401; `member` and `technical` → 403; never public).
- **Variants:** every item MUST have ≥ 1 variant with unique `label` (case-insensitive trimmed uniqueness within item; default single variant `label = "única"`), `quantity >= 0`, `minStock >= 0`. Derived fields: `totalQuantity = sum(variants.quantity)` and `lowStock = variants.any { it.quantity <= it.minStock }`.
- **Supplier reorder fields (`decisiones.md`):** optional `supplier`, `supplierContact`, `supplierReference`, `minOrderQty` (`>= 0`), `leadTime`, `lastOrderedAt` (`LocalDate`), and `unitCost` (`MoneyCents`), shown in the «Informació de comanda» modal and editable in «Edita l'article».
- **Atomic stock adjustment (`POST /api/v1/inventory-items/{id}/adjust`):** body `{"variant": "M", "delta": -1}` (**no `version`** required). Executed atomically in SQL (`UPDATE inventory_variants SET quantity = quantity + :delta WHERE item_id = :id AND label = :label AND quantity + :delta >= 0`): rejects archived items (`422`), unknown variant label (`404`/`422`), and any result `< 0` (`422 validation_failed`).
- **Atomic sale registration (`POST /api/v1/inventory-items/{id}/sell`, `decisiones.md`):** body `{"variant": "S", "quantity": 1, "unitPrice"?: 15.00}` (`quantity >= 1`, default `1`; **no `version`** required). Rejects archived items or items with `forSale == false` (`422`). Uses `unitPrice` if provided else `item.salePrice` (`422` if null). In one write transaction: atomically decrements `inventory_variants.quantity` (guarded by `quantity >= :qty`, else `422`), increments `inventory_items.units_sold += :qty` and `revenue_cents += :qty * unitPriceCents`, bumps `updated_at`, and returns the updated `InventoryItem`.
- **Summary formulas (`GET /api/v1/inventory-items/summary`, non-archived items only):**
  - `itemCount`: count of non-archived items.
  - `merchUnits`: sum of `quantity` across variants of items with `category = merch`.
  - `merchSaleValue`: sum of `variant.quantity * (item.salePrice ?: 0)` (`MoneyCents`) across items with `category = merch`.
  - `lowStockCount`: count of non-archived items where `lowStock == true`.
  - `uncountedCount`: count of non-archived items where `lastCountedAt == null` («per comptar»).
- **Archiving:** `DELETE /api/v1/inventory-items/{id}` sets `archived = true` (`204`); `?hard=true` is `admin` only (also deletes stored item image from `FILES_DIR`).
- **Protected images:** item photos are private (`board`/`admin` only); the web UI fetches thumbnails via `SessionManager.fetchAuthorizedBytes(thumbUrl)`.

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :server:test :app:shared:jvmTest :app:webApp:compileKotlinWasmJs` passes.
- Permission matrix verifies `anonymous` (401), `member` (403), `technical` (403), `board` (CRUD + 403 on `?hard=true`), `admin` (full + `?hard=true`).
- Concurrent `/adjust` and `/sell` requests decrement cleanly without losing updates and return `422` before going below 0; `/sell` accurately increments `unitsSold` & `revenue` and rejects `forSale == false` items.
- Web UI at `/inventari` matches reference mockups: clickable 5-card KPI filter strip (`Articles`, `Unitats de marxandatge`, `Valor de venda`, `Estoc baix`, `Per comptar`), search + category/status dropdowns, item rows with category badge, status badge, variant chips (low-stock red outline), `Preu de venda`, `Unitats venudes` / `Ingressos generats`, `REGISTRA VENDA` (or disabled `Este article no es ven`), `...` menu (`Consulta la comanda`, `Edita l'article`, `Marca com a comptat`), and modals (`Informació de comanda`, `Registra venda` with post-sale stock preview, `Edita l'article`, `Nou article`).
- `OpenApiRouteSyncTest` passes.
shared_ui_policy: All inventory UI, ViewModels, and repositories live in `:app:shared` `commonMain`. `:app:webApp` hosts wasm only. Android/desktop/JS out of v1 scope.
out_of_scope:
- Public catalog or online store / checkout.
- Stock movement audit log (future phase).
- Android, desktop, JS, iOS clients.

structure:
Vertical slice flow:

```text
Web /inventari (InventoryScreen → InventoryViewModel → InventoryRepository → MuixerangaApi)
  ↕ JSON + Multipart (Bearer, board/admin only)
Server InventoryRoutes → InventoryService (+ FileStorageService) → Inventory.sq (SQLite v0.2)
```

sections.title: Filters, sorting & variant integrity
sections.behavior: Creating/updating an item validates at least 1 variant, trims variant labels, checks uniqueness (`422 validation_failed` on duplicates), and ensures `quantity >= 0`, `minStock >= 0`, and non-negative `MoneyCents` prices.

sections.title: Atomic adjust, sales registration & concurrency
sections.description: Clicking `REGISTRA VENDA` opens the centered `Registra venda` modal showing item unit price, `Talla o variant` dropdown (showing current stock per variant), and a live preview box `Existències després de la venda`. Confirming sends `POST /api/v1/inventory-items/{id}/sell` and updates both the row (`Quantitats per talla`, `Unitats venudes`, `Ingressos generats`) and the KPI strip immediately. Direct stock edits or quick adjustments use `POST /adjust`.
sections.behavior: Server executes both `/adjust` and `/sell` inside `DatabaseAccess.writeTransaction` with guarded SQL `UPDATE` (`quantity >= :qty` / `quantity + delta >= 0`), so concurrent requests never produce negative stock and `/sell` atomically updates `units_sold` and `revenue_cents`.

endpoints.name: Register item sale atomically
endpoints.notes: `board`/`admin`. Body `{"variant", "quantity"?: 1, "unitPrice"?: MoneyCents}` (no `version`). Decrements variant stock (`422` if insufficient, archived, or `forSale=false`), increments `unitsSold` & `revenue`, returns updated `InventoryItem`.

endpoints.name: Upload / delete item image
endpoints.notes: Also `DELETE /api/v1/inventory-items/{id}/image`. `board`/`admin`. Protected file (max 10 MB). Upload rate limit.

persistence: Uses SQLite v0.2 `inventory_items`, `inventory_variants`, and `stored_files` via `Inventory.sq`. No new migrations.
